Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you turn the notes from the ventilation check in the fabrication workshop into a short handover note for the next shift? keep it to what was checked and what the notes actually say, so the person taking over can see the status without us filling in gaps. the extraction hood at the soldering bench was running, and the handheld reading at its grille was 0.42 m/s. the west wall fan was on and its indicator showed green, but nobody took an airflow reading there, so don't imply that one was measured. the side door was closed during the hood reading. i don't know whether that is the usual test setup, so include it as a detail rather than calling it pass or fail. please put the hood and fan information in separate bullets, and mention the door position with the hood reading. do not modify records; the existing maintenance log can be checked for the date, but no change to it is requested. you may list the readings in the handover note. if the date isn't stated in the notes, leave it out instead of guessing. keep the result as a short handover note, not a new inspection procedure.", "output": "Draft a short handover note for the next shift using the ventilation-check notes below. Include only what was checked and what the notes state; do not fill in gaps.

- Extraction hood at the soldering bench: running, with a handheld reading of 0.42 m/s at the grille. The side door was closed during this reading.
- West wall fan: on, with its indicator showing green. No airflow reading was taken, so do not imply that one was measured.

Mention the door position as a detail, not as a pass/fail result; it is not known whether this is the usual test setup. You may list the readings in the handover note. The existing maintenance log can be checked for the date, but do not modify records. If the date is not stated in the notes, leave it out rather than guessing. Keep the result as a short handover note, not a new inspection procedure."}]
